content:
#1 Over the last three days, I edited about 200 pages to resolve a problem that appears to originate around July 2009: for whatever mysterious reasons (perhaps Urs knows?), the Unicode characters inside [[...]] and [[!redirects ...]] were replaced by question marks, e.g., instead of [[Čech cover]] we would get [[?ech cover]]. Other common offenders included [[?Grpd]] instead of [[∞Grpd]] and [[?LieGrpd]] instead of [[∞LieGrpd]].

Through the use of regular expression search applied to the entire nLab repository, I believe I identified and fixed every single occurrence of this problem. As far as I was able to observe, it only occurs inside [[...]] and [[!redirects ...]] (any exceptions?).

I might have missed some instances of the problem. I would appreciate it if any unresolved ones could be pointed out in this thread, so that I can conduct a new search with potentially refined regular expressions to catch the yet-unidentified instances.
subject: Unicode problems in internal links resolved

content:
#2 Thanks for looking into this!

My memory is that our sysadmin at that time was doing some hoped-for improvement on the installation, in the course of which all these links were broken and we were told not to worry but to fix them when we see them. That’s my memory, I may be off.

It’s great that you took care of this issue now. Thanks!
subject: Unicode problems in internal links resolved
